title: Introducing Prism
summary: Prism is a free LaTeX-native workspace with GPT-5.2 built in, helping researchers write, collaborate, and reason in one place.
body: Prism is a free LaTeX-native workspace with GPT-5.2 built in, helping researchers write, collaborate, and reason in one place.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了Prism，这是一个集成了GPT-5.2的免费LaTeX原生工作空间，专门用于帮助研究人员在统一平台中进行学术写作、团队协作与复杂推理。原始信息显示：Prism is a free LaTeX-native workspace with GPT-5.2 built in, helping researchers write, collaborate, and reason in one place.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing Prism”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了内置GPT-5.2的LaTeX原生协作工作空间Prism，面向科研人员提供智能写作与推理支持。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
